title: Leveraging Dependency Grammar for Fine-Grained Offensive Language Detection using Graph Convolutional Networks
findings: The paper's findings are about the overall superior performance of its proposed model (SyLSTM) in detecting fine-grained offensive language. While religion is mentioned as a category of targeted hate speech (e.g., '#BanIslam'), the results are not broken down to provide specific findings on the model's performance on religious hate speech versus other categories.
